title: Harmonic Aristotle & ByteDance Seed-Prover Achieve First Formally Verified IMO Gold Medals
whyItMatters: Achieved the first machine-checked Lean 4 gold-medal performances at the International Mathematical Olympiad (5 of 6 problems), jumping from AlphaProof’s 2024 formal silver medal to verified gold in one year.
summary: Following IMO 2025 in July–October 2025, ByteDance Seed AI4Math’s Seed-Prover (arXiv:2507.23726) and Harmonic’s Aristotle (arXiv:2510.01346) independently delivered the first formally verified Lean 4 gold-medal-equivalent performances at the International Mathematical Olympiad, solving 5 of 6 competition problems with zero logical gaps. By pairing lemma-level neural reasoning, Monte Carlo tree search, and automated formal verification in Lean 4, Aristotle and Seed-Prover closed the gap between AlphaProof’s 2024 silver medal and fully machine-checked Olympiad gold—and Aristotle soon transitioned directly to open research problems, autonomously formalizing variants of Erdős Problem #124 and co-resolving Erdős Problem #728.
technicalHighlights: ByteDance Seed-Prover + Seed-Geometry formally proved 5 of 6 IMO 2025 problems in Lean 4 and solved 78.1% of formalized historical IMO problems.
Harmonic Aristotle achieved officially acknowledged IMO 2025 gold-medal-equivalent performance entirely in Lean 4 and later proved an open variant of Erdős Problem #124 autonomously.
Marked the maturation of neuro-symbolic Lean 4 provers from benchmark curiosity to general-purpose mathematical verification engines.
caveats: Olympiad problems are closed competition benchmarks rather than open conjectures, and Seed-Prover / Aristotle required formalized Lean problem statements and extended multi-hour search budgets compared to human exam rules.
contributors: Harmonic Aristotle Team (Tudor Achim et al.)

scoreRationale.foundational: Established the first formally kernel-verified gold-medal Olympiad proofs in Lean 4, proving neuro-symbolic provers could scale past AlphaProof’s 2024 silver.
scoreRationale.ripple: Aristotle directly powered 2026 open-problem formalizations (including Erdős #728), while Seed-Prover 1.5 went on to solve 11/12 Putnam 2025 problems.
scoreRationale.verification: Every competition solution is 100% machine-checked by the Lean 4 kernel with zero unproved gaps.
scoreRationale.velocity: Advanced formal theorem proving from IMO silver (4/6 in 2024) to IMO gold (5/6 in 2025) in 12 months.
